trade_thesis: Gold (XAUUSD) completed an aggressive parabolic expansion from 3659.4 to an intraday high of 3682.3, but the latest 15-minute candle has printed an 8.1-dollar upper rejection wick down to 3674.2 with declining volume (1,817 vs 3,489 on the expansion candle). This price action indicates an initial liquidity sweep of intraday stops above 3680 rather than sustained follow-through. With an account equity of $59.57, chasing long at the extreme peak of an extended leg exposes capital to immediate pullback risk, while shorting against the dominant trend lacks structural breakdown confirmation. A disciplined WAIT is enforced until price either retests and establishes support at the 3664-3666 breakout zone or prints a definitive continuation structure.
